findings.title: Recurring earnings matter
findings.finding: The reviewed financials identify a tax-related benefit in reported profit. Reported earnings growth therefore needs to be distinguished from recurring operating performance.
findings.investor_use: Helps assess whether recent profit growth is a sustainable basis for forecasts and earnings multiples.

findings.title: Growth and margins need to be assessed together
findings.finding: The reviewed company material describes volume-led growth alongside commodity, packaging and advertising-cost pressures.
findings.investor_use: Helps identify whether sales growth is translating into sustainable profitability.

findings.title: Cash generation deserves a separate check
findings.finding: Operating cash generation is a useful cross-check on reported profit, capital spending and working-capital movements.
findings.investor_use: Helps assess the capacity to fund reinvestment and shareholder distributions.
